title: Jacob's Dream and Vow

questions.question: What did Jacob see in his dream?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:12: Jacob saw a ladder with angels ascending and descending.

questions.question: What did Jacob name the place where he had the dream?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:19: He called the place Bethel (house of God).

questions.question: Where was Jacob traveling to?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:2: Jacob was sent to Paddan-aram to find a wife.

questions.question: Did God speak to Jacob in the dream?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:13: The LORD stood above the ladder and spoke to Jacob.

questions.question: What did Jacob set up as a pillar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:18: Jacob set up the stone he had used as a pillow.

questions.question: What did Jacob pour on the stone pillar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:18: Jacob poured oil on top of the stone.

questions.question: Who appeared to Jacob in the dream at the top of the ladder?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:13: The LORD stood above it.

questions.question: What was the original name of Bethel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:19: The city was formerly called Luz.

questions.question: What did Jacob use as a pillow?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:11: He took one of the stones and put it under his head.

questions.question: What fraction did Jacob vow to give to God?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:22: "of all that you give me I will give a full tenth to you."

questions.question: What did God promise about Jacob's offspring?
options: They would be like the dust of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: They would be like the dust of the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:14: "Your offspring shall be like the dust of the earth."

questions.question: What specific promise did God make about being with Jacob?
options: I am with you and will keep you wherever you go
questions.correctAnswer: I am with you and will keep you wherever you go
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:15: "I am with you and will keep you wherever you go."

questions.question: What was Jacob's response when he awoke?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:17: "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God."

questions.question: In which direction(s) would Jacob's offspring spread?
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:14: "spread abroad to the west and to the east and to the north and to the south."

questions.question: What condition did Jacob place on his vow?
options: If God will be with him and bring him back safely
questions.correctAnswer: If God will be with him and bring him back safely
questions.explanation: Genesis 28:20-21: Jacob's vow was conditional on God being with him and bringing him back in peace.

key_verse_text: 'Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land.'
